title: Actual-app verification and maximum-two output compliance
evidence_level: Actual application off/on regression and engineering-compliance verification; exposed related-group sample, not independent broad validation

tempo.endpoint: Strictly more than 8% exact BPM deviation; severe means strictly more than 50%.
tempo.interpretation: Exact tie: no net tempo accuracy or reliability gain. All eight direct-tempo outputs match prior component results; sample is exposed and related, not independent confirmation.

maximum_two_output_policy.scope: Global and section lead-output caps plus report metadata

candidate_adoption.decision: No new model adopted as default; existing optional/private experimental paths remain distinct from ordinary defaults.

other_scope.limits: Related cases and shared source group; no broad genre/audio-type/artist validation. Scalar BPM does not validate other analysis endpoints.
